India Imposes 162.5% Duty on Bulk Scotch Whisky Imports

India has imposed an effective duty and tax of 162.5 percent on bulk Scotch whisky imports from the United Kingdom. This rate is higher than the 150 percent previously levied before the India-UK trade agreement took effect. The move is reportedly linked to a dispute over customs classification.
